bienvenida.texto: The panel is already looking for the devices on your network. Before you see them, give it a name and a password so nobody else can get in.
bienvenida.codigo_ayuda: The installer showed it when it finished. If you don't have it, it is in the panel's log: journalctl -u panel-red | grep 'setup code' or, with Docker, docker logs panel-red. This way nobody else on your network can set the password before you.
bienvenida.nota: Keep it safe: if you forget it, you will have to reinstall the panel or delete its data.
primeros_pasos: {n} devices are unidentified. Give them a name and type to recognise them at a glance.
avisos.vacio: No changes yet. They will appear when a device joins or leaves the network.
graf.vacio: No readings yet. The first one takes under a minute.
graf.aria: Average download per slot. Maximum {max} Mbps
graf.teclas: Download chart. Use the left and right arrow keys to move through it
graf.nota: Average Mbps every {cada}. Total: {total}. Peak: {pico} Mbps, {cuando}.
graf.medido: Measured for {t}; the rest of the chart has no readings.
bajada.tope: Not measuring now: the router's counter is stuck at its maximum
bajada.parado: Not measuring now: the router's counter is not moving
bajada.sin_respuesta: Not measuring now: the router does not answer the counter
bajada.sin_upnp: Your router does not offer the internet counter (UPnP). If it has it, enable it in its settings.
mapa.ayuda: To place a device, open it and choose what it hangs from. Switches without an IP are added in
buscar: Search by name, IP or MAC
aviso.atrasados: The data may be out of date: {motivo}.
aviso.router_clave: the router rejects the saved password
aviso.router_error: the router could not be read ({msg})
aj.primera: Done. The panel is already scanning. If you have a supported router, connect it below (optional). Then go to Devices to name your devices.
aj.red_recortada: Your network ({red}) is too large to scan in full every minute: only {rango} is scanned. To choose other ranges, use the PANEL_RED variable (see the README).
aj.router_ayuda: Optional. With the password of the router's web page ({ip}), the panel knows which port or WiFi band each device uses. Read only: it logs in, reads and logs out every 5 minutes. The password is tested before it is saved.
aj.clave_otra_vez: Type it again to change anything
aj.router_guardado: Success: the router accepts the login and has been read.
aj.router_clave: The router rejected the password. It will not retry until you change it.
aj.router_error: Could not read it: {msg}. It will retry later.
aj.bocas_ayuda: Tell the panel what is plugged into each router port, so it can place new devices on the map by itself.
aj.nodos: Switches and access points without an IP
aj.nodos_ayuda: Devices without their own IP that are part of the wiring, like a simple switch. They appear on the map.
error.sin_sesion: Your session expired. Log in again.
error.padre_no_existe: What it is connected to no longer exists.
error.bucle: A device cannot hang from itself or from something that hangs from it.
error.tiene_hijos: Can't delete it: there are devices connected to it.
error.faltan_datos: The user or the password is missing.
error.clave: The router rejects the user or the password. Nothing was saved.
error.sin_router: The router has not been found yet. Wait for the first scan.
error.no_responde: Saved, but the router is not answering right now. It will retry.
error.espera: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
error.ya_configurado: The panel already has a password.
error.clave_corta: The password must have at least 8 characters.
error.interno: Something went wrong in the panel. Try again; if it keeps failing, check its log.
error.codigo_malo: That is not the setup code. Check the panel's log.
